tasks.subject: Task 7: Read each manifest once (ledger item 2)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** close the design's own ledger item 2 — `satisfies()` running twice on the winning candidate, once in `cache_candidates` and again in `check_venv_dir`, which re-reads the manifest from disk. This is a deliberate, design-sanctioned behaviour change.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/veny/cache_search.py`
- Modify: `tests/test_cache_search.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The current `read_manifest` / `satisfies` call counts for one cache hit are measured with counting spies and recorded BEFORE the change
- [ ] `find_match_dir_in_cache` keeps a `dict[Path, CacheCandidate]` and passes the already-read `manifest` into `check_venv_dir` at all three selection branches
- [ ] `check_venv_dir` with a supplied manifest performs zero `read_manifest` calls and one `satisfies` call
- [ ] The last-used path, which has no candidate, still reads the manifest itself
- [ ] A test counts the calls for a cache hit and pins the new numbers
- [ ] Mutation-checked: restoring `manifest=None` at one branch makes that test fail
- [ ] A folder that loses its manifest between the scan and the check is still handled; pin what happens now

**Verify:** `pixi run test tests/test_cache_search.py -q` → all pass, including the new call-count test

tasks.description:

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Every argument at every new call site in the plan's 14-row table has been substituted with an empty/None/default value, the suite run, and a NAMED test observed to fail; any argument with no named failure gets a test in this task
- [ ] Mutations are made in place and restored from a scratch copy — never `git stash`, never `git checkout -- <path>`
